title: NMSLFST
description: This plugin prevents players from losing their items when they die naturally
body: This plugin is designed to prevent players from losing motivation and quitting the game after dying and losing all their hard-earned items. Unlike keepInventory, it helps maintain a competitive environment by dropping items only when a player is killed by another player. This plugin prevents players from losing their items when they die naturally. Players only lose their items when killed by another player.
